research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: ScopeAR is focused on enhancing interactive experiences through augmented reality. Their development includes methods for augmented reality applications that involve capturing video images and generating AR coordinates. These are then transmitted to remote users, enabling real-time interaction and collaboration in an AR environment. This approach facilitates a seamless integration of virtual and physical elements, aiming to improve user engagement and interaction within augmented spaces. ScopeAR's R&D efforts are concentrated on creating immersive AR experiences.
